title: The Snail
planner: 14-colour CIE Lab k-means; connected components; median flat colours; skimage contours and approximate_polygon tolerance 3 px; principal-axis straight fills inside brush-radius-eroded polygons; 5–8 px exact-colour inset edge strokes; orange ground, white sheet, then coloured pieces largest to smallest; opacity 1 and no texture noise

credit.author: Tate, London
credit.note: Public domain in the EU; in copyright in some other countries.

description: Matisse's cut-paper spiral rebuilt as discrete flat pieces: an orange ground, a straight-edged ivory sheet, coloured polygon fills and crisp inset edges, ending with the small shapes and black square.

stages.label: Blocking in
stages.tip: Lay down the orange ground and the flat white sheet.

stages.label: Form and color
stages.tip: Fill each cut-paper piece with straight, opaque strokes.

stages.label: Refinement
stages.tip: Sharpen every straight edge without rounding the corners.

stages.label: Fine details
stages.tip: Restore the small coloured pieces and the black square.

scores.method: SSIM: grayscale, 384px longest side; deltaE2000: RGB Lab, 160px longest side; edges: reduced Sobel overlap; overall: 55% SSIM + 30% colour + 15% edges
